meta: Aqua NYC is the only venue inside the good band: $1,890 for 80 schedules, about $24 each, and schedules rose from 74 the week before.
Hutong Miami spent $1,598 for 18 schedules, roughly $89 each — well past the $50 poor threshold and down from 23 schedules last week. It is the least efficient line in the portfolio.
Hutong NYC sits at about $74 per schedule on $809. Both Hutongs are paying three times the good-band cost on Meta and warrant a creative or audience review.
google: Aqua NYC Google ran $762 for 29 booking conversions at roughly $26 CPA, just outside the $15 good band but the cheapest of the three.
Hutong Miami delivered 19 conversions on $568 at about $30 CPA, right on the poor threshold.
Hutong NYC is the weakest at about $61 per booking conversion on $1,160 — it spends the most on Google and converts the least.
ga4: Users fell 9 to 13 percent week on week at all three venues, but bookings rose at two of them, so conversion improved across the board.

Aqua NYC conversion at 4.4 percent against 7.9 percent last year is the one genuine deterioration; users are only 4.8 percent below last year, so this is a site and journey question, not a traffic one.
Hutong NYC remains 63 percent behind its year-to-date target, which is a target-setting question as much as a performance one — its conversion rate is up 45 percent year on year.
